title: Japanese-Style Grilled Chicken Yakitori
description: A classic Japanese dish featuring grilled chicken skewers, typically served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, and yakitori sauce.
4. Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
5. Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
7. Serve the grilled chicken skewers with a side of Japanese rice.
8. Garnish with charred scallions and a drizzle of yakitori sauce, if desired.
